comments.text: One of my best friends from college had lung cancer, and she didn't learn it was actually cancer till it was basically too late. She was fine at our wedding in October 2009; by September the following year, she was gone. So many younger people getting cancer. It's awful, and I hope Julian can get some answers and a good treatment and feel better very, very soon!
